parameters.content:
## 4.3.1 — Waha WhatsApp Reply Tracking

**Plan ID:** 4.3.1 (Phase 4 — Missing Channels + Reply Tracking)
**Sub-steps covered:** 4.3.1.1 (webhook), 4.3.1.2 (parse), 4.3.1.3 (Postgres update)

**Purpose:** Waha fires this webhook on every inbound/outbound WhatsApp event. This workflow filters for genuine inbound replies (fromMe=false) from a known lead/client, and updates `clients_master.last_reply_channel` / `last_reply_at`.

**Feeds into (not built yet):**
- 4.3.2 LinkedIn reply-check polling
- 4.3.3 Merge reply channels + nurture-suppression patch (adds `AND status != 'Replied'`-style filter into Module 2.2)

**ONE-TIME SETUP:** run the disconnected "ONE-TIME SETUP" Postgres node below manually once before activating this workflow (adds the two columns this workflow writes to).

## ⚠️ ONE-TIME SETUP — run manually before activating

This node is intentionally NOT connected to the trigger. Open it and click "Execute Node" once, manually, before you activate this workflow. It adds the two columns Phase 3 already reserved for Phase 4.3 (see master tracker §10A.1 / §11) using the mandatory `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` pattern — safe to re-run.

parameters.query:
ALTER TABLE clients_master ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_reply_channel TEXT;
ALTER TABLE clients_master ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_reply_at TIMESTAMP;

nodes.name: ONE-TIME SETUP - Add Reply Tracking Columns
nodes.notes: Disconnected on purpose — run manually once. See Migration Note sticky.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, name, phone
FROM clients_master
WHERE regexp_replace(phone, '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g')
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Find Client By Phone
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData=true so a no-match case still produces one item (carrying the upstream fields, with no 'id') instead of silently dropping — this is what lets the Unmatched branch below run at all.

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET last_reply_channel = 'whatsapp',
    last_reply_at = $1,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $2;

nodes.name: 4.3.1.3 - Update last_reply_channel/at
nodes.notes: Idempotent by construction: repeated deliveries of the same webhook event just overwrite last_reply_at/channel with the same values, never create a duplicate row.

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S5.1 — fires in parallel off '4.3.1.3 - Update last_reply_channel/at' success output, same branch as 'Respond 200 - Updated', so the webhook response isn't blocked waiting on the Hub round trip (same non-blocking pattern as Report to Hub in 1.4/1.5/2.3/2.5). client_id is $json.clientId (set by 'Compute Client Found Flag', guaranteed non-null on this branch since it only runs after 'Client Found?' passes true). odoo_lead_id is not selected by 'Find Client By Phone' (id, name, phone only) so this resolves to null/undefined — same as the 2.5 Report to Hub node when odoo_lead_id isn't in scope; funnel_events.odoo_lead_id is nullable so this is safe, not a silently invented value. NOTE: Hub-Dispatcher does not have a reply.received branch wired yet (S5b/S5.4 consumes it) — until that Switch branch is added, these events land in funnel_events and fall through to flagged_events, same safety net every other not-yet-wired event type gets.
